header.running_head: 3. Belief in the Events after Death...

blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب في الحوض رقم:٦٥٨١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Anas ibn Malik (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said, “While I was walking in Jannah, I passed by a river; on its two banks were domes made of hollowed pearls. “I asked Hazrat Jibra'il (AS) what this was, and he said, “This is the river “Kawthar’ which your Lord has given you’, and its (bed of) soil was fragrant musk”.

blocks.narrator: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-As (RA)
blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: حَوْضِي مَسِيرَةُ شَهْرٍ، وَزَوَايَاهُ سَوَاءٌ، وَمَاؤُهُ أَبْيَضُ مِنَ الْوَرِقِ، وَرِيحُهُ أَطْيَبُ مِنَ الْمِسْكِ، وَكِيزَانُهُ كَنُجُومِ السَّمَاءِ، فَمَنْ شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَا يَظْمَأُ بَعْدَهُ أَبَدًا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب اثبات حوض نبينا ..، رقم:٥٩٧١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-As (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said, “My pool (Hawd) spans a distance of one month. Its two corners are equal; its length and breadth are the same. Its water is whiter than silver, its fragrance is more fragrant than musk, and its drinking cups will be as many as the stars in the sky (countless). Whoever drinks from it once will never feel thirst again.”

blocks.text: Explanation:- “The pool spans a distance of one month” means that the length and breadth of the pool “Hawd-ul-Kawthar” which Allah has granted the Prophet ﷺ will be such that going from one side to the other is a journey of one month.
